title: VooPoo Argus A Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus A Vape Kit is a cutting-edge vape device that oozes wow-factor as well as effortless functionality and portability. Powered by a built-in 1100mAh battery, it supports a power range of 5-30W, catering to both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. The device features a unique dual-zone display with vivid animations and easy to read data settings, and subtle vibration alerts, making your vaping experience more engaging and fun. It also includes smart functions such as a device on/off slider, screen on/off function, and a user habits tracker. The Argus A is inhale activated and also offers stepless airflow adjustment to allow you to fine-tune your draw just the way you like it. Additionally, vapers can benefit from the Argus A’s 3 modes: SUPER that optimises your vape for your pod’s resistance; Power Mode which lets you adjust the wattage to your preference, and ECO mode with preserves your battery life. The Argus A comes with two 2ml Argus top-fill pods, each pre-installed with a mesh coil. The 0.4ohm pod is ideal for smooth and airy RDL vaping with 50/50 e-liquids while the 0.7ohm pod delivers an intensely flavoured MTL experience with nic salts. Both provide excellent flavour and smooth vapour production, with even more options available to try among the whole Argus Pod collection. The pods are designed for ease of use and leak-proof performance, ensuring a hassle-free vaping experience. With its sleek, smooth and durable zinc and aluminium alloy construction, the Argus A pod device is both robust and stylish. The device supports fast USB Type-C charging, ensuring minimal downtime between sessions. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced adult vaper, the Argus A offers an eye-catching, versatile and uniquely satisfying vaping experience. Browse our vaping juice and find the perfect companion for this kit. We Recommend using the following e-liquid with these pods: Voopoo Argus Top Fill 0.4ohm - Use High VG E-Liquids Voopoo Argus Top Fill 0.7ohm - Use 50/50 (Freebase) or Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
